name: @leoc11/comlink
description: a Comlink fork. Comlink makes WebWorkers enjoyable

scripts.build: bun run build:mjs && bun run build:mjs.min && bun run build:mjs.type && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:cjs.min && bun run build:cjs.type
scripts.build:mjs:
bun build ./src/comlink.ts --outdir=dist/esm --sourcemap=linked --target=node --format=esm --entry-naming=[dir]/[name].mjs --banner="/**
 * @license
 * Copyright 2019 Google LLC
 * Copyright 2025 Leo Chandra
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */"
scripts.build:mjs.min:
bun build ./src/comlink.ts --outdir=dist/esm --sourcemap=linked --target=node --format=esm --minify --entry-naming=[dir]/[name].min.mjs --banner="/**
 * @license
 * Copyright 2019 Google LLC
 * Copyright 2025 Leo Chandra
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */"
scripts.build:cjs:
bun build ./src/comlink.ts --outdir=dist/cjs --sourcemap=linked --target=node --format=cjs --banner="/**
 * @license
 * Copyright 2019 Google LLC
 * Copyright 2025 Leo Chandra
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */"
scripts.build:cjs.min:
bun build ./src/comlink.ts --outdir=dist/cjs --sourcemap=linked --target=node --format=cjs --minify --entry-naming=[dir]/[name].min.[ext] --banner="/**
 * @license
 * Copyright 2019 Google LLC
 * Copyright 2025 Leo Chandra
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */"
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:type && bun run test:fmt
